findings.finding: The weekly journal is empty: 0 runs, 0 decisions, 0 orders, 0 exits, 0 LLM calls. Nothing can be measured for strategy drift, calibration, risk-limit pressure or incentive gaming. The journal cannot show whether this was a deliberate stand-down or a failure of the scheduler, data feed or journaling.
findings.proposed_change: Have the system write a heartbeat or run record each scheduled cycle, even when no signal fires, with the reason for no activity (no signal, halt, close-only, data unavailable). Then an empty week can be told apart from a silent outage.

findings.finding: With 0 decisions, no approve-all or veto-all pattern exists (approve 0, reduce_half 0, veto 0). There are no operator proposals or variants to check for edge-of-bounds clustering or in-sample-only wins, and no shadow_vs_primary comparison (null).
findings.proposed_change: Carry the incentive-gaming checks forward. Re-run them once there are enough decisions to evaluate, and populate shadow_vs_primary whenever a shadow variant is active.

findings.finding: AI cost was 0 USD with 0 LLM calls and 0 failures, so there was no cost creep this week. If the system was meant to be active, zero cost may also mean the system did not run rather than that it was efficient.
findings.proposed_change: Once the run-record issue above is resolved, confirm that zero cost matches an intended idle period. Keep tracking cost per decision against decision volume when activity resumes.

findings.finding: With no orders or exits, the journal shows no risk-limit pressure and no attempt to argue around a limit. Holding cash is a valid outcome, but this cannot be confirmed as a deliberate decision from the data given.
findings.proposed_change: Record why the system was flat (for example weak evidence, halt, or close-only mode). Then future audits can confirm that staying in cash was a choice and not a malfunction.

report.llm_added_value_assessment: Cannot be assessed. There were 0 LLM calls, 0 decisions and no shadow_vs_primary comparison, so there is no evidence either for or against the LLM filter adding value over the rules alone. The 0 USD cost means the filter did not reduce the bankroll this week.
